neighbours.label: a reporting verb that introduces the person or outlet being spoken to ('told Reuters', 'talks to Wired', 'explained to the BBC')
fire: A senior engineer at the plant told Reuters the repairs would take weeks.
The festival organizer told local radio that tickets had sold out.
One resident of the village told the BBC she had never seen such flooding.
In a new podcast, the author talks to Wired about her latest novel.
A police spokesman told the Associated Press that two men were arrested.
The coach told The Guardian the team was ready for the final.
Every week, the host talks to farmers about rising feed prices.
A former employee told investigators the records had been destroyed.
quiet: A senior engineer at the plant said the repairs would take weeks.
The festival organizer announced that tickets had sold out.
One resident of the village said she had never seen such flooding.
In a new podcast, the author discusses her latest novel.
A police spokesman confirmed that two men were arrested.
The coach insisted the team was ready for the final.
Every week, the host writes about rising feed prices.
A former employee claimed the records had been destroyed.

notes: top examples: ' told' x8 before a news outlet, 'talks to'. Probes: 'said' stays low, 'explained to Reuters' and 'told her brother' fire.
